newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Semicon to invest heavily in TFT LCD.
newsitem.headline: LG Semicon to invest heavily in TFT LCD.

text.p: LG Semicon, an affiliate of South Korea's LG Group, said on Thursday it would invest 900 billion won by the end of this year in production lines for thin film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT LCDs).
The lines will have an annual production capacity of two million units.
The company said in a statement that mass production of the displays would start from 1998. Sales of the displays are expected to reach two trillion won by the year 2000.
LG Semicon, a semiconductor chip maker, said it was entering the TFT LCD business to counter the cyclical nature of the memory chip sector.
"If LG Semicon is diversified and able to follow the market environment in either direction, it will add more stability to its business structure," the company statement said.
